description: We are a creative team passionate about technology, space exploration, and storytelling. We aim to bring forgotten stories to life through an interactive web experience. We are interested in web development, React, 3D experiences, and data visualization. We welcome teammates skilled in frontend development, React Three Fiber, UI/UX design, research, and storytelling. Let's explore the unknown together!
summary:
StellarEcho is an interactive educational platform that brings the stories of humanity's forgotten space technology back to life. Developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, under the challenge "Abandoned But Not Forgotten," the project transforms space exploration history into an immersive 3D learning experience.

Users can explore celestial environments, discover real space missions and their abandoned equipment, and interact with detailed 3D models to understand the purpose, history, and scientific contributions of each artifact. The platform combines interactive visualization, educational content, and an AI-powered assistant to make complex space exploration concepts more accessible and engaging.

By connecting historical space missions with immersive digital experiences, StellarEcho helps students and space enthusiasts understand that even equipment left behind continues to tell important stories about human curiosity, engineering, and scientific discovery.
details:
Project Overview

StellarEcho is an interactive 3D educational platform designed to preserve and explore the history of human space exploration, with a special focus on abandoned space technology and equipment left behind during past missions.

How It Works

The platform allows users to explore an interactive 3D solar system and navigate between different planets. Each planetary destination provides educational information about historical space missions and the equipment associated with them.

Users can discover real spacecraft, rovers, landers, and other exploration equipment through dedicated 3D models. These models help users visualize the engineering behind each mission and understand what happened to the equipment after its mission ended.

StellarEcho also features Astro AI, an AI-powered assistant that allows users to ask questions and receive explanations about space exploration, planetary science, missions, and related technologies.

Benefits and Intended Impact

StellarEcho makes space exploration history more accessible, engaging, and easier to understand. Instead of relying solely on traditional text and static images, users can interact with 3D environments and models, encouraging curiosity, exploration, and independent learning.

The project aims to help students and space enthusiasts appreciate the scientific and historical value of abandoned space technology and recognize that these artifacts remain important parts of humanity's journey beyond Earth.

Technology and Development

StellarEcho was developed using React, TypeScript, and Vite for the frontend, with React Three Fiber powering its interactive 3D environments and planetary visualizations.

AI-assisted development tools included Google Gemini (Argon) and Anthropic Claude (Opus), which supported code implementation, debugging, problem-solving, and development optimization.

Google Gemini was also integrated into the platform through Astro AI, providing users with an interactive AI-powered assistant for exploring space-related topics.

The development process focused on performance, usability, educational accuracy, and creating an engaging interactive learning experience.

Creativity and Innovation

StellarEcho combines interactive planetary exploration, historical space technology, detailed 3D visualization, and an AI-powered educational assistant into one unified experience.

Its core idea is to transform forgotten space equipment into interactive educational experiences, allowing users to explore not only where humanity has traveled, but also what it has left behind.
